scope: BeauSana local interface source; connect, task-list, task-details and action handlers
result: Conformance not established; one confirmed source-level failure and three risks requiring browser reproduction
browser_automation: Unavailable: privileged native pipe bridge is not available; browser-client is not trusted

structural_source_checks.evidence: Initial title in HTML; route titles reviewed in app.js

structural_source_checks.check: All input controls have explicit labels

structural_source_checks.evidence: 42 unique IDs; this is not an obsolete 4.1.1 criterion check
Skip link points to focusable main

structural_source_checks.check: No positive tabindex in static markup
structural_source_checks.evidence: Native DOM order; dynamic focus still needs browser verification
Persistent status and alert regions; actual JAWS announcements not tested
No maximum-scale or user-scalable restriction; 200% zoom not tested
No paste prevention or cognitive challenge in local authentication; Asana token creation is external

findings.title: Eight-hour authentication limit has no adjustment or extension
findings.evidence: server.mjs defines SESSION_TTL as eight hours, removes expired sessions and sets a matching cookie lifetime. There is no turn-off/adjust/extend control or advance warning.
findings.recommendation: Offer a user-controlled session extension with advance warning and at least 20 seconds to respond, repeatable at least ten times, or allow adjustment/turn-off before the limit starts.

findings.title: Failed initial task load can leave focus in a hidden view
findings.evidence: enterTasks hides the connection view via show('tasks'), but only loadTasks success moves focus to tasks-heading. Its catch branch does not move focus. Slow or failed retrieval after connecting has no immediate focus transfer.
findings.recommendation: Move focus to the tasks heading immediately when changing views, independently of request success, and verify failure navigation with a keyboard.

findings.title: Saving disables the focused action controls
findings.evidence: saveAction disables the entire task-actions fieldset and reload button. Focus is restored only after the async operation finishes. Native details summaries remain interactive outside disabled form-control semantics.
findings.recommendation: Use focus-preserving busy states with explicit activation guards, or move focus to a stable labeled progress element, then test Tab and Shift+Tab during a delayed save.

findings.title: Some dynamic strings have no long-word wrapping rule
findings.evidence: Instruction, comment and heading text can wrap long words. Uploaded-file list items, project metadata in task-list paragraphs and recipient text in buttons do not explicitly do so.
findings.recommendation: Verify long filenames, project names and recipient names at 320 CSS pixels and under text-spacing overrides; add wrapping where overflow is observed.

manual_checks_remaining: Keyboard-only connect/demo/list/details, Enter and Space activation, Tab/Shift+Tab order, no trap (2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.3)
JAWS names, roles, expanded/collapsed states, errors, validation and announcements (1.3.1, 3.3.1, 4.1.2, 4.1.3)
200% text resize, 400% browser zoom/320 CSS-pixel reflow and text-spacing overrides (1.4.4, 1.4.10, 1.4.12)
Rendered focus visibility and focus not obscured across scroll positions, including expanded forms (2.4.7, 2.4.11)
Rendered target dimensions and spacing; account for inline-link exceptions (2.5.8)
Delayed, failed and ambiguous save/upload responses, expired connection and draft recovery
Review/correct/reverse actual changes to user-controlled data, particularly handoff (3.3.4)
Dynamic Asana instructions/comments in other languages and lost rich-text relationships (1.3.1, 3.1.2)
Forced-colors mode and browser-native controls including file picker
Full applicable A/AA criterion review before any conformance claim; source checks do not establish overall compliance
